quotes.text: To be a successful founder, you have to believe that what you're working on is going to work — despite knowing it probably won't!
quotes.author: David Heinemeier Hansson
quotes.source: Believe it's going to work even though it probably won't

quotes.text: The best thing about work is getting the opportunity to exercise your human capacity for creativity, ingenuity, progress.
quotes.author: David Heinemeier Hansson
quotes.source: How it started / how it's going

quotes.text: You have to build up the reasoning from the ground up from first principles as in the phrase that's used in physics.
quotes.author: Elon Musk

quotes.text: Just showing up is half the battle. You gotta try hard to do it, and don't be afraid of failure.
quotes.author: Elon Musk

quotes.text: Capitalism is a way of thinking, a mindset that invites you to save and work.
quotes.originalText: El capitalismo es una forma de pensar, una forma mental que te invita a ahorrar y trabajar.
quotes.author: Miguel Anxo Bastos
quotes.source: Discurso en el Instituto Juan de Mariana

quotes.text: I am. I think. I will.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.text: Anyone who fights for the future, lives in it today.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.text: If liberty means anything at all, it means the right to tell people what they do not want to hear.
quotes.author: George Orwell

quotes.text: From the skin inward begins my exclusive jurisdiction. I choose what may or may not cross that border. I am a sovereign state, and the boundaries of my skin are far more sacred to me than the political borders of any country.
quotes.originalText: De la piel para dentro empieza mi exclusiva jurisdicción. Elijo yo aquello que puede o no cruzar esa frontera. Soy un Estado soberano, y las lindes de mi piel me resultan mucho más sagradas que los confines políticos de cualquier país
quotes.author: Antonio Escohotado

quotes.text: Truth stands on its own; only lies need government subsidy.
quotes.originalText: La verdad se impone sola; solo las mentiras necesitan subvención del gobierno
quotes.author: Antonio Escohotado

quotes.text: Nothing has such power to broaden the mind as the ability to investigate systematically and truly all that comes under thy observation in life.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Often injustice lies in what you aren't doing, not only in what you are doing.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Our minds largely determine the quality of our lives.
quotes.author: Sam Harris

quotes.text: Your mind is all you truly have. So it makes sense to train it.
quotes.author: Sam Harris

quotes.text: There's real poetry in the real world. Science is the poetry of reality.
quotes.author: Richard Dawkins

quotes.text: The feeling of awed wonder that science can give us is one of the highest experiences of which the human psyche is capable.
quotes.author: Richard Dawkins

quotes.text: The essence of the independent mind lies not in what it thinks, but in how it thinks.
quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens

quotes.text: Time spent arguing with the faithful is, oddly enough, almost never wasted.
quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens

quotes.text: First stop lying, then start speaking the truth.
quotes.author: Jordan B. Peterson

quotes.text: Responsibility, man: that's where the meaning in life is.
quotes.author: Jordan B. Peterson
quotes.source: Maps of Meaning 11: The Flood and the Tower

quotes.text: You're a community across time.
quotes.author: Jordan B. Peterson

quotes.text: Freedom is always under threat, so we must keep renewing the reasons for defending it.
quotes.originalText: La libertad siempre está bajo amenazas y, por tanto, siempre hay que renovar las razones para defenderla.
quotes.author: Juan Ramón Rallo

quotes.text: Economic freedom is an end in itself to a believer in a free society. It is also an indispensable means toward the achievement of political freedom.
quotes.author: Milton Friedman

quotes.text: A society that puts equality — in the sense of equality of outcome — ahead of freedom will end up with neither.
quotes.author: Milton Friedman

quotes.text: The more I do whatever the hell I want, the better life goes for me.
quotes.originalText: Cuanto más hago lo que me sale de los huevos, mejor me va en la vida.
quotes.author: C. Tangana
